@eng-42 From the on_hand_by_location design review notes I have: positions that net to exactly zero are DROPPED from the result — an emptied bin is not a stock position and must not show on count sheets/transfer screens. Negative totals are kept as-is (they flag a missed receipt and must stay visible). So test_totals (excludes zero-qty) is the correct expectation; test_regression_issue_118 (includes them) is the stale one. Your impl excluding zeros is right.
